name: Reggie Absolom
bio: Reggie Absolom is a British actor. He is best known for playing Arlo in Club Kid (2026). He has also appeared in the Apple TV+ series Silo and the BBC series The Other Bennet Sister.

credits.title: Club Kid
credits.overview: A hard-partying New York City club promoter sees his whirlwind lifestyle upended by the arrival of the 10-year-old son he never knew he had.

credits.title: Dressed to the Nines
credits.overview: A coming-of-age short film about a young boy who believes dressing up to the nines will keep his mum with him forever.
